title: Functional-only release distillation (--functional-only) and confined in-tree symlinked-license harvest resolution
goal: Implement deterministic functional vs. non-functional task and commit classification in `distill plan` and `local-distill` (`plan`, `compose`, `orchestrate`) under `--functional-only` so non-functional receipt, release-record, docs, and chore commits are skipped without blocking functional dependents or triggering out-of-scope diffs while recording `functional_only` and `skipped_non_functional_tasks` in plan manifests and distillation receipts and passing `task_records`, `distill lint`, and `release-qualify --from-distill`; close the multi-crate symlinked-license gap in `xtask/src/harvest.rs` by resolving Git `120000` license and NOTICE symlinks strictly confined inside the quarantined commit tree (<= 4 hops, regular blob target) while continuing to hard-reject symlinked source files; and add end-to-end integration tests in `tests/functional_distillation.rs`.
limitations: Symlink resolution is deliberately restricted to nearest license and NOTICE evidence inside the pinned quarantined commit tree (<= 4 hops, regular file blobs only); symlinked source files remain hard-rejected.
